data.title: SWARM-ECOM-AUTONOMY v2.0
data.mission_parameters: {"primary_targets":{"expansion":"Execute \"Recommended Actions\" by developing products in highlighted niches: AI-Generated Art, Eco-Friendly, Hobby-Based, Vintage/Retro, Fitness, Travel, Home Office.","optimization":"Increase performance of existing \"Active Product Listings\" (e.g., \"Art Deco Cityscape,\" \"AI Prompt Guide\").","financial_automation":"Ensure all revenue is automatically aggregated and transferred to the central PayPal account (\"My Account\") without manual intervention.","activation":"Move all \"Idle\" streams to \"Active\" and meet/exceed their listed revenue targets."},"risk_mitigation_ethical_constraints":["TOS Compliance: All LISTER_GAMMA actions screened against platform policies. No IP infringement. AI art modified.","Stealth Operations: Agent activity mimics human patterns (randomized delays, varying creation styles).","Fail-Safe: If agent/store flagged, SENTINEL isolates, notifies, redeploys.","Transparency: Products accurately described. No fake reviews."],"deployment_phases":{"phase_1_weeks_1_2":"Consolidation & Activation - SENTINEL establishes secure connections, LISTER_GAMMA audits and populates stores, SUPPORT_EPSILON configures auto-responses. Target: Zero \"Idle\" statuses.","phase_3_weeks_7_12":"Scale & Diversify - Launch remaining niches, PROMO_DELTA cross-promotes, SENTINEL refines financial automation.","phase_4_ongoing":"Full Autonomy & Reinvestment - Swarm operates with minimal oversight, a portion of revenue reinvested by SENTINEL.","phase_2_weeks_3_6":"Optimization & Niche Launch - RESEARCH_ALPHA prioritizes \"Pet-Themed\" and \"Mental Health\" niches, CREATOR_BETA creates AI art, LISTER_GAMMA lists across platforms, PROMO_DELTA launches targeted campaigns."},"core_directive":"Transform idle and underperforming revenue streams into active, profitable assets. Launch new product lines in identified high-demand niches. Achieve full autonomy in operations and financial settlement.","swarm_intelligence_communication":"Agents communicate via a centralized message bus using standardized JSON. SENTINEL listens to SALE_CONFIRMED events.","financial_settlement_protocol":{"steps":["Collection: Revenue from sales settles in each platform's connected seller account.","SENTINEL Monitoring: SENTINEL pings each platform's API every 2 hours checking for \"available for payout\" balances.","Trigger: If balance > platform minimum payout threshold, SENTINEL initiates transfer.","Execution: SENTINEL uses OAuth tokens/API keys to command the platform to send funds to the pre-registered, verified Central Command PayPal Account (My Account).","Verification & Logging: SENTINEL confirms transfer initiation, logs transaction ID, expected arrival date, and amount.","Central Command Receipt: Funds arrive in My Account. Mission success."]},"success_metrics_kpis":{"autonomy":"99.9% of operations (listings, customer service, promotion) handled by swarm.","revenue":"Total transferred to Central Command ≥ Combined targets of all active streams.","velocity":"Launch of 3-5 new products per week per active niche.","listings":"100% of managed stores have ≥ 10 active, optimized listings."},"dependent_on":"INF-001"}
